claim.text: QUAD results printed by TEST01 for f07, f08, f12, f13 (EPSIL 0.001), against the registered values

attempt: Original: shipped Makefile as documented fails (f77 absent; then src.f not beside driver.f). Patched: conda-forge gfortran via micromamba in the sandbox fetch step; F77 passed as a make variable; src.f copied beside driver.f; no source edits. Two passes (-O, then clean -O0 rebuild) give identical output, byte-equal to the shipped res file. f07, f08, f12 within tolerance; f13 is not (QUAD reports ICHECK 1, value 0.0135495 vs 0.01349248565, diff 5.7e-5 against tol 1.35e-5).

original_attempt.reason: make (shipped Makefile, default compiler) stops: f77 not found; with F77=gfortran, make stops: No rule to make target 'src.f', needed by 'src.o' (src.f is in Fortran/Sp/Src/, not beside driver.f)
